references.text: The spies recommended that only two to three thousand men should go up, which led to the defeat described in verse 4.
The continuation of the defeat at Ai, where the men of Ai killed about thirty-six Israelites.
God warned that Israel would flee before their enemies if they were disobedient to Him.
Moses predicted that disobedience to the Lord would lead to Israel being defeated and fleeing before their enemies.
A previous incident where the Israelites were defeated and driven back by the enemy due to sin and disobedience.
A similar situation where the Israelites fled before the enemy in battle, with parallel language about flight.
The psalmist describes how God let the people flee before the enemy, a consequence of sin similar to the defeat at Ai.
